status_semantics: verified-candidate identifies repaired client consumers with synthetic acceptance and independent review; this verified candidate is now installed, but no live provider behavior or production activation is claimed. blocked-activation identifies old owners that the installed admission gate correctly refuses. excluded-by-plan means an unselected capability is not deployed.

severity_semantics.P1: Block affected capability/cutover until resolved or explicitly waived; conditional reachability is described.
severity_semantics.P2: Required repair or explicit scoped waiver; not automatically a global provider failure.

update_contract: Preserve IDs; update status, evidence and acceptance together. Do not promote static findings to observed without an executed consumer.

risks.title: Ambiguous refresh exchange can redeem the same token twice
risks.summary: A consumed synthetic R0 followed by response loss leaves the row active. A subsequent getApiKey sends R0 again; synthetic invalid_grant then disables the row. Durable lease/CAS does not make the remote exchange exactly-once. Crash, failed persistence, or lease takeover can leave the same ambiguity.
risks.remediation: Keep 0090 and add a durable per-row/token-generation exchange reservation before the POST. Never redeem an ambiguous generation again merely because a lease expired. Persist a known replacement before returning it; quarantine an unknown outcome and require recovery/reauth unless the provider supplies proven idempotency or recovery. This trades availability for credential safety.
risks.acceptance: V02: after simulated response loss, a second caller must issue zero additional POSTs for R0; a successful R1 survives waiter cancellation and owner commit races. No claim about actual provider revocation or grace windows.
risks.verification_boundary: Actual repaired18.10.0 synthetic consumer; exact unchanged-source or affected-consumer18.10.1 evidence tracked in latest release acceptance. No production-provider claim.

risks.remediation: Persist the effective model and thinking/effort selection on every successful writable branch/fork adoption in #branchIntoNewSession; preserve explicit fallback and ephemeral semantics. Do not fix only navigateTree.
risks.acceptance: V01: A->B, fork before B, send and flush, dispose, reopen in a fresh process: next serialized request and restored UI remain B with the same effort.

risks.summary: The real injector loses an earlier stamped message and restamps a later one after a session-ID change. Actual fork/import paths create a new ID but do not carry the date-cwd-anchors artifact. Full SDK wire-prefix capture for this path was not executed.
risks.remediation: Move anchor ownership into the session-owned persisted artifact set, or copy exact anchors atomically when cloning history; retain explicit-empty state and survive process restart.
risks.acceptance: V01: historical date/cwd bytes before a fork/import must equal those in the first fresh-process request afterwards; only new messages may receive new anchors.

risks.title: Effective Codex lane sentinel is swallowed by outer compact() catch
risks.summary: model.api=openai-responses with remoteCompaction.api=openai-codex-responses enters chain-only V2, throws CodexCompactionChainLostError, but the outer catch checks the native API and enters V1. One full-history /responses/compact request was intercepted.
risks.remediation: Rethrow the typed chain-loss sentinel unconditionally at the outer compaction boundary; use the effective-lane predicate for transport policy, reserving native-api checks for serializer typing.
risks.acceptance: V03: call compact(), not only requestCompactionV2Streaming, with the alternate effective API; assert typed terminal refusal and zero V1/SSE sends.

risks.title: Entitlement rejection bypasses the chain-only SSE prohibition
risks.summary: With an eligible account/model and a live ordinary WS chain, a buffered invalid_access_program error strips access_programs and directly opens SSE. This path bypasses the transport-exception guard and can submit full history. No local-WS reproduction was executed; a drafted probe was removed.
risks.remediation: Enforce the compaction no-SSE invariant at every SSE admission, including buffered-error entitlement retries. Keep ordinary-turn entitlement recovery, reconnect via generate:false, and typed failure on exhausted chain recovery.
risks.acceptance: V03, after implementation approval: one eligible-account local-WS error case must make zero SSE/V1 sends; ordinary-turn entitlement recovery remains permitted. Do not add an unrelated transport suite.
risks.verification_boundary: Actual repaired18.10.0 synthetic consumer; exact unchanged-source or affected-consumer18.10.1 evidence tracked in latest release acceptance. No production-provider claim.

risks.title: Anthropic cache-control retry bypasses fallback-credit forfeiture protection
risks.summary: Actual streamAnthropic retries a cache_control 400 without fallback_credit_token despite refusedContent containing an anthropicServerTool. The new retry rung calls prepareParams directly, bypassing credit-aware rebuildParams. This proves a tokenless replay, not actual provider rebilling.
risks.remediation: Route both cache-control retry rungs through rebuildParams(streamFailure), which invokes forfeitFallbackCredit and stops unsafe server-tool replay. Preserve the target credit protocol for safe requests.
risks.acceptance: V04: a credited server-tool refusal followed by cache-control rejection must stop before a tokenless second request; a safe text-only case may follow the existing credit-aware policy.
risks.verification_boundary: Actual repaired18.10.0 synthetic consumer; exact unchanged-source or affected-consumer18.10.1 evidence tracked in latest release acceptance. No production-provider claim.

risks.summary: forkIfMovedAway is called at CLI startup, but selector/RPC/ACP resume reaches switchSession -> setSessionFile without that guard. A departed source may continue writing its old ID while the destination owns the same lineage.
risks.remediation: Enforce moved-marker handling at the common writable session-adoption boundary, including selector, RPC and ACP. Preserve read-only transfer inspection and cancellation/rollback ownership.
risks.acceptance: V06: mark a synthetic source moved; in-process writable adoption must fork/refuse by policy rather than append to the departed ID; read-only inspection remains nonmutating.

risks.title: Session import compares journals before acquiring ownership
risks.summary: unpack classifies local transcript prefixes before claiming the session lease. A live owner may append and release between comparison and claim; the import can then publish older incoming bytes and delete the set-aside newer transcript.
risks.remediation: Acquire session-ID ownership before discovering/reading/classifying writable local journals; revalidate any new copies under that ownership and hold it through publication. Never delete a divergent backup as a mere successful-prefix replacement.
risks.acceptance: V06: deterministic append-between-discovery-and-claim schedule must retain the new local message or refuse import; equal/prefix imports still complete without duplicate identities.
risks.verification_boundary: Actual repaired18.10.0 synthetic consumer; exact unchanged-source or affected-consumer18.10.1 evidence tracked in latest release acceptance. No production-provider claim.

risks.title: Devin AssignModel auth rejection does not invalidate cached auth
risks.summary: AssignModel runs before the chat retry and throws on 401/403; the cached JWT remains reusable until expiry, so later turns repeat the same failure.
risks.remediation: Include assignment auth rejection in the same bounded auth-cache invalidation/refresh loop as chat; exactly one fresh retry, while non-auth assignment failures remain terminal.
risks.acceptance: V09: assignment 401 then success must refresh once and use the new JWT; non-auth failure must not refresh or retry.

risks.summary: The retained audit recognizes legacy context_management.pause_after_compaction, while the actual native request uses top-level compaction.type=summarize. It may skip the compact comparison and overwrite the ordinary baseline.
risks.remediation: Classify the real top-level envelope and keep compaction/main baselines separated. This repairs diagnostics, not a demonstrated provider cache defect.
risks.acceptance: V04: pass the actual native builder output through the diagnostic and assert compact classification plus unchanged ordinary baseline.

risks.title: Side requests can contaminate cache-miss attribution
risks.summary: cache-prefix-audit-extension keys a mutable diff by session+payload model, then associates message_end usage. Same-model title/side requests can replace the main comparison and produce an unsupported MISS CAUSED BY attribution.
risks.remediation: Correlate request and completion by stable request identity, provider, wire model, purpose and lineage; compare system/tools inside that lineage rather than making their hash part of the key. Missing correlation must report unknown, not a cause.
risks.acceptance: V08: same-model main/side interleaving cannot borrow payload diffs or populated headers. Request diffs explicitly report request-only correlation; completion usage reports unavailable correlation and unknown cause when no stable request identity is supplied. Privacy remains sample-free.
risks.verification_boundary: False causal attribution is removed. Full request/completion correlation is not claimed.

risks.title: Equal DB versions do not prove safe journal/auth rollback
risks.summary: Reviewed agent schema 6 and auth schema 8 remain unchanged, so no new schema-migration defect is asserted. New journal semantics, token rotations, ownership markers and native/daemon IPC can still make a code-only or stale-data rollback unsafe.
risks.remediation: Preserve the whole runtime/native/ledger closure and immutable old source paths. Never restore token state as code rollback. Production admission must exclude old credential-capable owners/spawn authorities; code installation is distinct from activation. Deployment is explicitly authorized; no additional approval is required.
risks.acceptance: V10/V11: validate synthetic resume/import plus process ownership and code-only rollback shape; do not infer safety from schema integers or restore stale token snapshots.
risks.operational_state: Code installation and publication complete. Captured old sessions/brokers remain live; installed launcher refuses normal production launch with exit75. No forced retirement, current-session upgrade or production admission occurred. Exit old owners normally before launching; pre-admission code rollback remains available.
